title: Audit Verify — payload
description: Request to verify the integrity of a maintainer's append-only audit hash chain. The request carries no parameters — verification is store-wide.

Response.title: Audit Verify — response payload
Response.description: The outcome of walking the audit log in chronological order and checking each envelope's hash links. `verified` is true only when every chainable envelope re-derived its own `entryHash` and pointed at its predecessor's. When false, `chainBreak` locates the first failure.

verified.description: True iff the chain is internally consistent end-to-end: every examined envelope re-derived its `entryHash` and its `prevHash` matched its predecessor. See Security & Privacy — this proves consistency, NOT authenticity.

entriesExamined.description: Total envelopes walked, including those skipped.

entriesVerified.description: Envelopes whose links were actually checked (examined minus skipped).

legacySkipped.description: Envelopes stepped over because they predate the hash-chain format. A value > 0 on a store that should hold none is itself a finding — skipped envelopes are an insertion point, not a verified prefix.

unparseableSkipped.description: Envelopes that could not be deserialized and so could not be checked. Reported at the same prominence as a break, not swallowed.

head.description: The `entryHash` of the newest envelope reached, in the same multibase-multihash encoding the envelope carries it. Absent when the log is empty.

chainBreak.description: Present iff `verified` is false — the first inconsistency found. Absent when verified.

ChainBreak.title: ChainBreak
ChainBreak.description: Locates the first envelope at which chain verification failed.

kind.description: `tamperedEntry`: the envelope's content changed after writing, so its `entryHash` no longer re-derives. `brokenLink`: the envelope's `prevHash` does not point at its predecessor's `entryHash` — a reorder, drop, insertion, or duplication.

index.description: Zero-based position in chronological order of the offending envelope.

eventId.description: Identifier of the offending envelope, when it has one (an unparseable envelope may not).
